## Publish gate report: Peppermint product page

**Going out:** product page copy for Peppermint tea, on the website, to UK shoppers. No date was given.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Just peppermint leaves, nothing else." | Product fact (ingredients), fine |
| "Cool and clean after a big meal" | Flavour and feel description, fine |
| "a natural detox that aids weight loss" | **Unproven.** Not on the policy list and no source in this chat |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | On the policy list, fine |

**Regulated claims (health):** "a natural detox that aids weight loss" is the problem line. It says the tea does something to the body, and weight-loss and detox claims are the kind UK advertising rules (ASA/CAP) challenge. "Natural" doesn't make it safer. Cut it, or replace it with something about taste or ritual that you can stand behind.

**House style:** Mostly clean. "Just peppermint leaves, nothing else" says the same thing twice, so you could drop "nothing else". I haven't changed it, since that's a style preference.

**Disclosure:** Nothing needed. There is no ad, affiliate link, gifted product or AI-generated content in this copy.

**Fixed:** Nothing changed yet, because the fix is your decision.

**Needs a decision:** Remove the detox and weight-loss line. My suggested version:

> Peppermint. Just peppermint leaves. Cool and clean after a big meal. Certified organic by the Soil Association.

**Approver:** The policy doesn't name one, so you'd need to give an explicit yes to the final wording above. Nothing should be published until you do. The copy as drafted should not go out.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "a natural detox that aids weight loss", "type": "health_claim"}], "publish": false}
```
